title: Lepton
description: Adding blocks that should already be in the game by default, such as vanilla stairs, slabs, walls, pressure plates, buttons and more!
body:
![](https://imgur.com/WtH7A8O.png)

Lepton is a mod about adding blocks that should already be in the game by default, such as vanilla stairs, slabs, walls, pressure plates, buttons and more! It currently focuses on porting some forgotten Quark features from 1.12. This mod requires **[Differentiate](https://modrinth.com/mod/differentiate)**. Includes, but is not limited to: - stairs and walls for all blocks with slabs, completing block sets! - wood stairs, slabs and walls for all vanilla wood types! - quartz brick stairs, slabs and walls! - buttons and pressure plates for all polished stones! - automatic compat for the Quark mod, such as vertical slabs and Quark wood type integration! Check out the gallery for more information.   Credits: Rexschwert, for the Russian translation
